patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: excavator of Lothal (S.R. Rao), Kalibangan's district (Hanumangarh), Dholavira habitation span (3000-1800 BCE), which site is in India (Lothal).
'Not a Harappan site' odd-one-out with Sohgaura as the trap recurs (UPSC 2019, APPSC G2).

River/location of sites (Harappa-Ravi, Lothal-Bhogava, Kalibangan-Ghaggar) and site-find matches (ploughed field-Kalibangan, plough model-Banawali, dockyard-Lothal, signboard-Dholavira) are staple facts across PSCs.
App leans heavily on 'how many of the following' and multi-statement items with excavation years and minor finds; APPSC shows far simpler single-fact framing.
Boundary sites (Manda-Daimabad-Alamgirpur-Sutkagendor) and largest Indian site (Rakhigarhi) are high-yield.
